resources.string: Your phone stops buzzing.\nNothing gets lost.
Quiet Inbox silences distractions by default, saves everything to a private offline archive, and lets the people and apps that matter break through.

Quiet Inbox requires Notification Access to detect incoming notifications, silence distracting alerts, and save your notification history locally on your device.\n\nAll notification content is processed entirely on your device. Quiet Inbox contains no internet permission, so your personal messages and data never leave this phone, are never collected, and are never shared with anyone.
